title: Credit Memos on the Commercial Credit Account and Courtesy Reversal of Finance Charges
content:
A credit memo posts only to a Commercial Credit Account whose status is active, on hold or in collections; the account's status in the system record decides.

### Where a credit memo is applied

1. A credit memo produced by a return, a contract price claim, a dispute or a finance charge waiver is applied to the invoice that billed the credited item or charge.
2. A rebate payout memo, and any credit whose invoice is already paid in full, is held on account as an open credit that the next payment or refund draws on.

| Origin of the credit | Applied to |
|---|---|
| return, contract price claim, dispute, finance charge waiver — invoice still open | the invoice that billed the credited item or charge |
| any of those — invoice already paid in full | held on account as an open credit |
| rebate payout | held on account as an open credit |

### Courtesy reversal

3. The desk may reverse a late payment finance charge as a courtesy by credit memo of the full charge amount when the number of courtesy reversals already granted is below the tier's yearly courtesy allowance; returned payment fees, card convenience fees and paper invoice fees are never waived as a courtesy.
4. Courtesy reversals already granted are counted as the finance charge waiver credit memos on the account dated within the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the current date, both ends included.

### Amount and payout

5. Credits are never paid out in cash at the time they are issued; a credit balance is refunded only under the refund and small-balance write-off rules.
6. A credit memo amount is exactly the credit determined by the policy that produced it and is never rounded further.

*Hypothetical:* on a tier allowing 1 courtesy reversal a year, an account with no waiver memo in the last 12 months may have one finance charge of 18.40 reversed by a memo of 18.40; with one such memo already dated inside the 12 months, no further courtesy reversal is available.
